updates.title: The Speed Builders Update
updates.summary: Speed Builders gets the attention it deserves: a timer, personal bests, world records and six new challenges. Plus game recaps, weekly challenges you can actually see, and a settings screen.

sections.heading: Speed Builders
items: A timer while you build, with your best time on that build next to it
Personal bests for every build, saved even when you're offline
Better Battle world records, with a leaderboard for each build on the website
Precision: how many of your clicks actually ended up in the build

sections.heading: New challenges
items: Feet on the Ground: win a Speed Builders game without flying
Good Enough: win without a Perfect Build in every round
Assembly Line: win placing one block type at a time
Photo Finish: a Perfect Build with less than a second left
From the Bottom: win after the slowest Perfect Build in round 1
Speedrunner: win with every round under 15 seconds
Measure Twice now works: win without breaking a single block

sections.heading: After every game
items: A recap in chat: placement, grade, crowd score, XP and what you unlocked
Last Game in the B menu shows the full breakdown, round by round
Share a card of your profile from the website

sections.heading: Everything else
items: Weekly challenges in the B menu and on your profile, with a countdown to the Monday reset
See how rare each achievement is, and compare yourself with another player
A Settings screen: every new feature can be switched off if you'd rather play normally

updates.title: First release
updates.summary: Better Battle tracks your Build Battle games, grades your builds and puts you on a global ranking.

sections.heading: Highlights
items: Every game saved on your computer first, then synced
Grades, crowd score and the Aspiring Level
Over 100 achievements, many unlocked from your existing Hypixel stats
Profiles and a global ranking at battle.aspir3.net
